definitions.explanation: A person's former boyfriend. A casual, colloquial term common in conversation and on social media.

examples.japanese: {元|もと}カレから{連絡|れんらく}が{来|き}た。
examples.english: I got a message from my ex-boyfriend.

examples.japanese: {元|もと}カレとは{今|いま}でも{友達|ともだち}だ。
examples.english: I'm still friends with my ex-boyfriend.

examples.japanese: {元|もと}カレの{話|はなし}は、あまりしたくない。
examples.english: I don't really want to talk about my ex-boyfriend.

notes:
Colloquial contraction of {元|もと}の{彼氏|かれし} ('former boyfriend'), with カレ written in katakana. Common in casual speech and text messages.

RELATED WORDS:
- {元|もと}カノ: ex-girlfriend
- {彼氏|かれし}: boyfriend
- {元彼|もとかれ}: the same word written in kanji
